title: Software Quality Engineer ( Mid-Level or Senior)

cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Mid-Level or Senior Software Quality Engineer to join our team.
Our team of engineers partners with programs to help develop and maintain a culture of first-time quality throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a member of this team, you have the autonomy and responsibility to work with programs to assure the process for developing, controlling, and verifying software products is planned and complied with, and effectively improving the quality of our software products – whether developed internally or provided by suppliers.
This position may require up to 10% travel.
This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship.
Export Control Requirements: U.S. Government Export Control Status: This position must meet export control compliance requirements. To meet export control compliance requirements, a ""U.S. Person"" as defined by 22 C.F.R. 120.15 Is required. ""U.S. Person"" includes U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Actively participates in program activities, from initial proposal and planning to and delivery
Coordinates support across SQEs supporting a program, as necessary, to ensure SQE commitments are met
Performs process and product audits to verify software lifecycle activities and products comply with approved software processes, plans, and standards
Supports program milestone and formal review meetings, occasionally preparing and presenting information
Verifies that software testing is done to meet software requirements
Performs final reconciliation of software data products
Conducts root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions and other defect activities
Teams with equipment managers of supplier products to monitor and evaluate supplier software development performance
Acts as an independent set of eyes and ears for Program Managers and the customer, highlighting potential best practices on the team, as well as areas for improvement
Supports the identification and analysis of program/project software quality metrics to improve software quality and manage risk
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, or chemistry
3+ Years work related experience with Software Development lifecycle (including Requirements Analysis, Design, Code, Integration & Test)
1+ Years of experience in Quality Management Systems (QMS)
5 Or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience with products developed using Agile software development practices
Preferred Requirements:
3+ Years of software quality engineering experience supporting software with AS9115, DO-178, and/or MIL-STD-882E requirements
Experience with DevSecOps and associated tools
Typical Education/Experience:
Mid-Level (Level 3)
Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 5 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. PhD, Master+3 years' related work experience). ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.
Senior (Level 4)
Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 9 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. PhD+4 years' related work experience, Master+7 years' related work experience). ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

cond_0055.intro:

Our team of engineers partners with programs to help develop and maintain a culture of first-time quality throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a member of this team, you have the autonomy and responsibility to work with programs to assure the process for developing, controlling, and verifying software products is planned and complied with, and effectively improving the quality of our software products – whether developed internally or provided by suppliers.

Verifies that software testing is done to meet software requirements
Performs final reconciliation of software data products

cond_0063.intro:
We are looking for a Mid-Level or Senior Software Quality Engineer to join our Defense, Space, and Security division.
Our team works alongside program engineers to help build and maintain a culture of first-time quality throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As part of this team, you will coordinate with programs to help ensure that the processes for developing, controlling, and verifying software products are planned, followed, and continuously improved — whether the software is developed internally or provided by suppliers.
A broad background in software development practices, tools, and processes is important, along with a commitment to First Time Quality strategies. Experience with Agile and familiarity with quality standards (e.g. AS9100 / AS9115) is strongly preferred. Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills are essential.
This position may require up to 10% travel.
cond_0063.responsibilities:
Work alongside program teams across all phases, from initial proposal and planning through delivery
Coordinate support across SQEs on a program, as needed, to help ensure SQE commitments are met
Conduct process and product audits together with program staff to verify that software lifecycle activities and products comply with approved processes, plans, and standards
Support program milestone and formal review meetings, occasionally helping prepare and present information
Help verify that software testing is carried out to meet software requirements
Collaborate on final reconciliation of software data products
Work with teams on root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions and other defect activities
Partner with equipment managers of supplier products to monitor and evaluate supplier software development performance
Share observations and insights with Program Managers and the customer, highlighting potential best practices as well as areas for improvement
Support the identification and analysis of program/project software quality metrics to help improve software quality and manage risk

Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited program in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, or chemistry
3+ Years of experience with the Software Development lifecycle (including Requirements Analysis, Design, Code, Integration & Test)
1+ Years of experience in Quality Management Systems (QMS)
5 Or more years of related work experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Experience with products developed using Agile software development practices
3+ Years of software quality engineering experience supporting software with AS9115, DO-178, and/or MIL-STD-882E requirements
Experience with DevSecOps and associated tools

cond_0161.intro:
[Company name masked] is seeking Mid-Level or Senior Software Quality Engineers to join its Defense, Space, and Security division.
As a member of this team, you will own the responsibility of working with programs to ensure the process for developing, controlling, and verifying software products is planned and complied with, and driving effective improvement of software product quality — whether developed internally or provided by suppliers.
The right candidate will bring a broad background in software development practices, tools, and processes, along with a commitment to First Time Quality strategies. Experience with Agile and knowledge of quality standards (e.g. AS9100 / AS9115) is strongly preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills, are crucial for success.
This position may require up to 10% travel.

Own final reconciliation of software data products
Lead root cause analysis and direct implementation of corrective actions and other defect activities
Partner with equipment managers of supplier products to monitor and evaluate supplier software development performance
Serve as an independent set of eyes and ears for Program Managers and the customer, identifying potential best practices as well as areas for improvement

[Company name masked] is seeking Mid-Level or Senior Software Quality Engineers to join its Defense, Space, and Security division.
Our team of engineers partners with programs to help develop and maintain a culture of first-time quality throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a member of this team, you have the autonomy and responsibility to work with programs to assure the process for developing, controlling, and verifying software products is planned and complied with, and effectively improving the quality of our software products – whether developed internally or provided by suppliers.
The successful candidate will have a broad background in software development practices, tools, and processes combined with a focus on advocating First Time Quality strategies. Experience with Agile and knowledge of quality standards (e.g. AS9100 / AS9115) is strongly preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills, are crucial for success.
People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of software quality processes and how they apply across the development lifecycle.
This position may require up to 10% travel.
cond_0229.responsibilities:
Actively participates in program activities, from initial proposal and planning to and delivery
Coordinates support across SQEs supporting a program, as necessary, to ensure SQE commitments are met
Performs process and product audits to verify software lifecycle activities and products comply with approved software processes, plans, and standards
Supports program milestone and formal review meetings, occasionally preparing and presenting information
Verifies that software testing is done to meet software requirements
Performs final reconciliation of software data products
Conducts root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions and other defect activities
Teams with equipment managers of supplier products to monitor and evaluate supplier software development performance
Acts as an independent set of eyes and ears for Program Managers and the customer, highlighting potential best practices on the team, as well as areas for improvement
Supports the identification and analysis of program/project software quality metrics to improve software quality and manage risk
cond_0229.requirements:
This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship.
Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study, in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry
3+ Years work related experience with Software Development lifecycle (including Requirements Analysis, Design, Code, Integration & Test)
1+ Years of experience in Quality Management Systems (QMS)
Experienced with products developed using Agile software development practices
5 Or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
3+ Years of software quality engineering experience supporting software with AS9115, DO-178, and/or MIL-STD-882E requirements
Experience with DevSecOps and associated tools
Mid-Level (Level 3): Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 5 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. PhD, Master+3 years' related work experience). ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.
Senior (Level 4): Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 9 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. PhD+4 years' related work experience, Master+7 years' related work experience). ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

cond_0299.intro:

Our team of highly-motivated, customer-focused engineers partner with BDS programs to help develop and maintain a culture of first-time quality throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a member of this team, you have the autonomy and responsibility to work with programs to assure the process for developing, controlling, and verifying software products is planned and complied with, and effectively improving the quality of our software products – whether developed by [Company name masked] or provided by suppliers.
The successful candidate for this position will have a broad background in software development practices, tools, and processes combined with a passion for advocating First Time Quality strategies. Experience with Agile and knowledge of quality standards (e.g. AS9100 / AS9115) is strongly preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills, are crucial for success.

Verifies that software testing is done to meet software requirements
Performs final reconciliation of software data products

Our team of engineers partners with programs to help develop and maintain a culture of first-time quality throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a member of this team, you have the autonomy and responsibility to work with programs to assure the process for developing, controlling, and verifying software products is planned and complied with, and effectively improving the quality of our software products – whether developed internally or provided by suppliers.
This position may require up to 10% travel.
This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship.
Export Control Requirements: U.S. Government Export Control Status: This position must meet export control compliance requirements. To meet export control compliance requirements, a ""U.S. Person"" as defined by 22 C.F.R. 120.15 Is required. ""U.S. Person"" includes U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.
cond_0415.responsibilities:
Actively participates in program activities, from initial proposal and planning to and delivery
Coordinates support across SQEs supporting a program, as necessary, to ensure SQE commitments are met
Performs process and product audits to verify software lifecycle activities and products comply with approved software processes, plans, and standards
Supports program milestone and formal review meetings, occasionally preparing and presenting information
Verifies that software testing is done to meet software requirements
Performs final reconciliation of software data products
Conducts root cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions and other defect activities
Teams with equipment managers of supplier products to monitor and evaluate supplier software development performance
Acts as an independent set of eyes and ears for Program Managers and the customer, highlighting potential best practices on the team, as well as areas for improvement
Supports the identification and analysis of program/project software quality metrics to improve software quality and manage risk
cond_0415.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, or chemistry
3+ Years work related experience with Software Development lifecycle (including Requirements Analysis, Design, Code, Integration & Test)
1+ Years of experience in Quality Management Systems (QMS)
5 Or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience with products developed using Agile software development practices
Preferred Requirements:
3+ Years of software quality engineering experience supporting software with AS9115, DO-178, and/or MIL-STD-882E requirements
Experience with DevSecOps and associated tools
Typical Education/Experience:
Mid-Level (Level 3)
Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 5 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. PhD, Master+3 years' related work experience). ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.
Senior (Level 4)
Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 9 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. PhD+4 years' related work experience, Master+7 years' related work experience). ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard.

[Company name masked] is looking for Mid-Level or Senior Software Quality Engineers to join its Defense, Space, and Security division.
Our team of engineers takes ownership of partnering with programs to build and sustain a culture of first-time quality across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). In this role, you will be accountable for ensuring that the processes for developing, controlling, and verifying software products are planned, followed, and continuously improved — whether the software is developed internally or supplied externally.
The right candidate will bring a solid background in software development practices, tools, and processes, and will champion First Time Quality strategies. Experience with Agile and knowledge of quality standards (e.g. AS9100 / AS9115) is strongly preferred. Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills are essential.
This position may require up to 10% travel.
cond_0458.responsibilities:

Direct SQE support across a program, as needed, to ensure commitments are met

Lead participation in program milestone and formal review meetings, including preparing and presenting information as needed
Ensure software testing is carried out to meet software requirements
Own final reconciliation of software data products
Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective actions and other defect resolution activities
Lead engagement with equipment managers of supplier products to monitor and evaluate supplier software development performance
Serve as an independent set of eyes and ears for Program Managers and the customer, identifying best practices and areas for improvement
Spearhead the identification and analysis of program/project software quality metrics to improve software quality and manage risk

3+ Years of experience with the Software Development lifecycle (including Requirements Analysis, Design, Code, Integration & Test)
1+ Years of experience in Quality Management Systems (QMS)
